name: Mitsue
text: Mitsue (御杖村, Mitsue-mura) is a village located in Uda District, Nara Prefecture, Japan. As of 1 April 2024, the village had an estimated population of 1393 in 782 households, and a population density of 18 persons per km2. The total area of the village is 79.58 km2 (30.73 sq mi).

depictions.name: Mitsue
depictions.text: Mitsue, Nara Mitsue is a town south of Asuka Rocks in Yamato, Japan.
